title: strip-browser_use-prefix-in-debug-logs
request: Can you make the debug log formatter also strip the 'browser_use.' prefix like the info formatter does? Right now DEBUG logs still show the full module path.
reference_diff:
--- a/browser_use/logging_config.py
+++ b/browser_use/logging_config.py
@@ -94,7 +94,7 @@
 
 		def format(self, record):
 			# Only clean up names in INFO mode, keep everything in DEBUG mode
-			if self.log_level > logging.DEBUG and isinstance(record.name, str) and record.name.startswith('browser_use.'):
+			if self.log_level >= logging.DEBUG and isinstance(record.name, str) and record.name.startswith('browser_use.'):
 				# Extract clean component names from logger names
 				if 'Agent' in record.name:
 					record.name = 'Agent'

+import io
+import logging
+from browser_use.logging_config import setup_logging
+
+def test_debug_log_name_stripping():
+    # Set up logging to capture output in a StringIO stream
+    stream = io.StringIO()
+    # Force re-setup each time
+    logger = setup_logging(stream=stream, log_level='debug', force_setup=True)
+
+    # Create a logger with a long browser_use name
+    test_logger = logging.getLogger('browser_use.tools.foo')
+    test_logger.debug('test message')
+
+    output = stream.getvalue()
+    # The full logger name should be stripped to just 'tools'
+    assert 'browser_use.tools.foo' not in output
+    assert '[tools]' in output
+    # Ensure the level and message appear
+    assert 'DEBUG' in output
+    assert 'test message' in output
